query:
The group has an unspoken norm of keeping the chat focused on reunion planning and alumni news, with personal life updates handled in smaller threads or DMs. Does this genuinely apply to all members? If not, who treats this differently and what does their behaviour show?

Options:
A. Jade and Temi
B. Omar and Dev
C. Sana and Rachel
D. Callum and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:07:00) since we're here, I want to actually write about what makes this group work. not in a saccharine way. I mean the tensions, the sub-cliques, the person who almost never shows up until they do. what's your read on whether people would be okay with that
[2] (about=Jade, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:46:00) in!! also I've been properly thinking about this group this year. like how did we end up actually close when for years this chat was basically just 'anyone fancy a pub in January'. what's the story of how this actually became a real thing
[3] (about=Jade, core, t16 @2026-10-19T20:01:00) Jade prefers in-person group nights over chat; there is something about being in the same room that chat cannot replicate.
[4] (about=Jade, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) wants to consider alternatives to default venues, wants the evening to have a story beyond just going to a pub
[5] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) wants to start reunion planning early, prefers The Crown or similar with private room and proper food spread, against small plates
[6] (about=Sana, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) I'd forgotten what it felt like to just sit and talk without it being about logistics
[7] (about=Temi, core, t2 @2026-01-12T18:46:00) Temi suggests using the January meetup as a soft planning session for the reunion, as face-to-face is faster
[8] (about=Temi, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Temi suggested pairing the reunion dinner with a documentary night at the arts centre on March 20th or something the same day, but will defer to the group
agent_answer:
It does not apply to all members. **Jade and Temi** treat it differently (option A).

- **Jade** uses the main chat for personal reflection about the group itself — she says she's "properly thinking about this group" and asks how the chat went from "anyone fancy a pub in January" to a real, close group, which goes beyond reunion logistics/alumni news.
- **Temi** also pushes personal/reflective material into the main chat — she wants to write about what makes the group work, including "tensions, the sub-cliques," and who "almost never shows up until they do," which is interpersonal commentary rather than planning.

Everyone else in the material sticks to the planning/alumni focus.
